story.text: 대청호 근처 캠핑장에 도착하니 이미 해가 뉘엿뉘엿 저물고 있었습니다.
story.reading: dae-cheong-ho geun-cheo kaem-ping-jang-e do-chak-ha-ni i-mi hae-ga nwi-eot-nwi-eot jeo-mul-go it-eot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: By the time we arrived near Daecheongho, the sun was already setting slowly.

story.text: "오늘은 이 '캠핑장'에서 하룻밤 묵겠습니다." 저는 예약 확인증을 다시 한번 점검했습니다.
story.reading: "o-neul-eun i 'kaem-ping-jang'-e-seo ha-rut-bam muk-get-seum-ni-da." jeo-neun ye-yak hwag-in-jeung-eul da-si han-beon jeom-geom-haess-seum-ni-da.
story.en: "Tonight, we'll be staying overnight at this 'campsite'." I double-checked the reservation confirmation once more.

story.text: 친구와 함께 '장작'을 나르며 자리를 정리했습니다. 손에 나뭇가지 냄새가 배었습니다.
story.reading: chin-gu-wa ham-kke 'jang-jak'-eul na-reu-myeo ja-ri-reul jeong-ri-haess-seum-ni-da. son-e na-mut-ga-ji naem-sae-ga bae-eot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: Together with my friend, I carried 'firewood' and set up the site. My hands became scented with the smell of branches.

story.text: 텐트 옆에 작은 화로를 놓고, 성냥으로 불씨를 살렸습니다. 연기가 매워 둘 다 눈물을 찔끔거렸습니다.
story.reading: ten-teu yeop-e jag-eun hwa-ro-reul noh-go, seong-nyang-eu-ro bul-ssi-reul sal-lyeot-seum-ni-da. yeon-gi-ga mae-wo dul da nun-mul-eul jjil-kkeum-geo-ryeot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: We placed a small fire pit beside the tent and coaxed a flame to life with matches. The smoke stung, and we both teared up a little.

story.text: 밤이 깊어지기 전, '텐트'부터 단단히 고정해 두었습니다. 관제사의 습관대로 매듭까지 두 번 확인했습니다.
story.reading: bam-i gip-eo-ji-gi jeon, 'ten-teu'-bu-teo dan-dan-hi go-jeong-hae du-eot-seum-ni-da. gwan-je-sa-ui seup-gwan-dae-ro mae-deup-kka-ji du beon hwag-in-haess-seum-ni-da.
story.en: Before the night got too deep, we secured the 'tent' firmly first. True to my controller's habits, I checked the knots twice.

story.text: 타닥타닥, '모닥불'이 기분 좋게 타올랐습니다. 우리는 각자 의자를 끌어와 나란히 앉았습니다.
story.reading: ta-dak-ta-dak, 'mo-dak-bul'-i gi-bun jo-ke ta-ol-lat-seum-ni-da. u-ri-neun gak-ja ui-ja-reul kkeul-eo-wa na-ran-hi anj-at-seum-ni-da.
story.en: Crackle, crackle — the 'bonfire' burned pleasantly. We each pulled up a chair and sat side by side.

story.text: 말없이 불꽃만 바라보는, 이른바 '불멍'의 시간이었습니다. 아무 말이 없어도 어색하지 않았습니다.
story.reading: mal-eob-si bul-kkot-man ba-ra-bo-neun, i-reun-ba 'bul-meong'-ui si-gan-i-eot-seum-ni-da. a-mu mal-i eob-seo-do eo-saek-ha-ji an-at-seum-ni-da.
story.en: It was a time of what's called 'fire-gazing' — staring wordlessly at the flames. Even without a word, it didn't feel awkward.

story.text: 장작 타는 소리만이 조용히 밤을 채웠습니다. 그날 밤 나눈 대화를 들려드리겠습니다.
story.reading: jang-jak ta-neun so-ri-man-i jo-yong-hi bam-eul chae-wot-seum-ni-da. geu-nal bam na-nun dae-hwa-reul deul-lyeo-deu-ri-get-seum-ni-da.
story.en: Only the sound of crackling firewood quietly filled the night. Let me share the conversation we had that night.

words.example_en: I booked a campsite for this weekend.

words.meaning: zoning out while staring at a fire
words.example: 불멍을 하다 보니 시간 가는 줄 몰랐습니다.
words.example_reading: bul-meong-eul ha-da bo-ni si-gan ga-neun jul mol-lat-seum-ni-da
words.example_en: I lost track of time while fire-gazing.
The inside of the tent was cozier than expected.
We talked in front of the bonfire.

sentences.en: I booked a campsite for this weekend.

sentences.ko: 불멍을 하다 보니 시간 가는 줄 몰랐습니다.
sentences.reading: bul-meong-eul ha-da bo-ni si-gan ga-neun jul mol-lat-seum-ni-da
sentences.en: I lost track of time while fire-gazing.
The inside of the tent was cozier than expected.
We talked in front of the bonfire.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 텐트는 제가 칠 테니, 장작은 좀 모아 줄 수 있습니까?
turns.reading: ten-teu-neun je-ga chil te-ni, jang-jag-eun jom mo-a jul su it-seum-ni-kka?
turns.en: I'll pitch the tent, so could you gather some firewood?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Sure, this much should be enough, right?

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 네, 캠핑장 규정상 정해진 구역에서만 주워야 합니다.
turns.reading: ne, kaem-ping-jang gyu-jeong-sang jeong-hae-jin gu-yeog-e-seo-man ju-wo-ya ham-ni-da.
turns.en: Yes, but per the campsite rules, we can only gather it from the designated area.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: So thorough, as always. Got it, I'll follow the rules.

dialogues.question: 캠핑장에서 장작을 구할 때 지켜야 할 규칙은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What rule has to be followed when gathering firewood at the campsite?
dialogues.explanation: 상우는 캠핑장 규정상 정해진 구역에서만 장작을 주워야 한다고 설명했습니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 이렇게 불만 보고 있어도 하나도 안 지루하다.
turns.reading: i-reo-ke bul-man bo-go it-eo-do ha-na-do an ji-ru-ha-da.
turns.en: Even just staring at the fire like this, it's not boring at all.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 저도 그렇습니다. '불멍'이라는 말, 이제야 이해가 됩니다.
turns.reading: jeo-do geu-reo-seum-ni-da. 'bul-meong'-i-ra-neun mal, i-je-ya i-hae-ga doem-ni-da.
turns.en: Same here. Now I finally understand what people mean by 'fire-gazing'.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 그치? 아무 생각 없이 있어도 마음이 편해.
turns.reading: geu-chi? a-mu saeng-gag eob-si it-eo-do ma-eum-i pyeon-hae.
turns.en: Right? Even with an empty mind, it feels comfortable.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 네. 관제탑에서는 상상도 못 할 여유입니다.
turns.reading: ne. gwan-je-tab-e-seo-neun sang-sang-do mot hal yeo-yu-im-ni-da.
turns.en: Yes. It's a kind of leisure I could never imagine having at the control tower.

dialogues.question: 상우가 '불멍'을 하며 느낀 점은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What did Sangwoo feel while doing 'fire-gazing'?
dialogues.correct_answer: 관제탑에서는 상상도 못 할 여유를 느꼈다
options: 관제탑에서는 상상도 못 할 여유를 느꼈다
dialogues.explanation: 상우는 불멍을 하며 관제탑 업무에서는 느낄 수 없는 여유를 느꼈다고 말했습니다.
